name: vg-brain-marketplace
description: Voyageur Group — VG Brain plugins (secret-less, OAuth). Pick the plugin for your OS: vg-brain-mac (zero-install macOS), vg-brain-windows (zero-install Windows x64), or vg-brain (cross-platform, requires Node — fallback).

plugins.name: vg-brain-mac
plugins.description: VG Brain for macOS — ZERO-INSTALL, no Node needed. Bundled mcp-remote binary + /bin/sh arch shim (Apple Silicon + Intel). RBAC, audit log, full-text search, automatic session capture. OAuth (no baked secret). Recommended for Mac.

plugins.name: vg-brain-windows
plugins.description: VG Brain for Windows x64 — ZERO-INSTALL, no Node needed. Bundled mcp-remote .exe. UNTESTED in Cowork on Windows pending the Mark-of-the-Web / SmartScreen check; not yet verified. Windows-arm64 not covered (use the npx 'vg-brain' fallback). OAuth (no baked secret).

plugins.name: vg-brain
plugins.description: VG Brain — cross-platform FALLBACK. Launches mcp-remote via 'npx', so it REQUIRES Node.js on the machine. Use only if the OS-specific zero-install plugin doesn't fit (e.g. Windows-arm64, or before vg-brain-windows is verified). RBAC, audit log, full-text search, automatic session capture. OAuth (no baked secret).
